goals.title: Add a staff record
goals.summary: A new staff record with the details you give, kept as a draft for you to check.
goals.text: Add a staff record for [full name], who joins as [job title] on [start date]. Their email is [email address] and they report to [manager]. Keep it as a draft for me to check and tell me if any detail looks missing.

goals.title: Prepare a leave request
goals.summary: A leave request for one person, ready for you to approve.
goals.text: Prepare a leave request for [full name] for [type of leave] from [first day] to [last day]. Note the reason as [reason]. Leave it as a draft for me to approve and tell me how many working days it takes.

goals.title: Attendance for a day or a week
goals.summary: Who was in, who was away and who was late, for the period you name.
goals.text: Show me attendance for [day or week]. List who was present, who was away and who was late, with one line on anything that looks unusual.

goals.title: Who is on leave
goals.summary: Everyone who is away in a period, with their dates.
goals.text: List everyone who is on leave between [first day] and [last day], with the dates and type of leave for each. Point out any days when more than [number] people are away together.
